sloka: प्राप्तव्यं तु दशायोगान्मयैतदिति निश्चितम् ।दासीनां रावणस्याहं मर्षयामीह दुर्बला ।। ६.११६.४१ ।।
transliteration: prāptavyaṁ tu daśāyogānmayaitaditi niścitam ।dāsīnāṁ rāvaṇasyāhaṁ marṣayāmīha durbalā ।। 6.116.41 ।।

translations.english: "Foremost of Vanaras! Who will be angry? Being under the command of the king and being obedient maids, they did so according to king's order.
